name: mmm-mcp-server
description: Read and write your nested mind maps and to-dos in Matryoshka Mind Map.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your Matryoshka Mind Map account. Ask Claude to list your maps, turn a conversation into a nested mind map, import Markdown, or check off a task by saying "I finished it".

Sign in from the conversation: ask Claude to sign in to Matryoshka, and a browser window opens. Approve with the Google or Apple account you use in the app, or enter your email and password on the sign-in page. The page runs only on your computer, and your password is never shared with the AI.

The extension runs only on your computer and talks to your own account directly. The first time a map's contents are read, Claude asks for your permission.

Get the app (free to start): https://matryoshkamap.web.app

tools.name: sign_in
tools.description: Sign in with Google, Apple, or email in the browser

tools.name: list_elements
tools.description: Read the items of a map (asks for permission the first time)

tools.name: auto_structure_thought
tools.description: Add a nested structure of items to a map

tools.name: edit_element
tools.description: Edit the text of an item

tools.name: set_schedule
tools.description: Set due dates and start dates
